S.FORM: Talawadaw no pangcah Talawadaw a Niyaor,iteni i fata'an tangsa' i pusku ci sra a ci nakaw o lalengawan si no pangcah i tira ci lagasan ko olip na no to'as ci sra a ci nakaw o tatapangan si no pangcah na i tira ci langasan maepod taila kiwit sa ci wawa san ci nakaw ci tapang masra ci calaw panahay,ci karo o korol citomay i masra i tira say i amis i tira ciwidian hananay a nirao o yanan a fikeloh i tira say i sapat oroma' ni tapangya masra ci calaw panahay i tira say i kiwit ci karo o kowol i tira i tafalong o tenod kono kiwit o kawal kono tafalong o danoang kono nataoran hatira'ay korairay tonano o toas hatira'ay kolenak no mita o pangcah
S.PHON: taɾawaɬ~ɮaw no~u paŋʦaħ taɾawaɬ~ɮaw a nijao~ur,itəni i fataʡan taŋsaʡ i po~u~usko~u~u ʦi sra a ʦi nakaw o~u ɾaɾəŋawan si no~u paŋʦaħ i tira ʦi ɾa*asan ko~u o~uɾip na no~u to~uʡas ʦi sra a ʦi nakaw o~u tatapaŋan si no~u paŋʦaħ na i tira ʦi ɾaŋasan maəpo~uɬ~ɮ taiɾa kiwit sa ʦi wawa san ʦi nakaw ʦi tapaŋ masra ʦi ʦaɾaw panaħaj,ʦi karo~u o~u ko~uro~uɾ ʦito~umaj i masra i tira saj i amis i tira ʦiwiɬ~ɮian ħananaj a nirao~u o~u janan a fikəɾo~uħ i tira saj i sapat o~uro~umaʡ ni tapaŋja masra ʦi ʦaɾaw panaħaj i tira saj i kiwit ʦi karo~u o~u ko~uwo~uɾ i tira i tafaɾo~uŋ o~u təno~uɬ~ɮ ko~uno~u kiwit o~u kawaɾ ko~uno~u tafaɾo~uŋ o~u ɬ~ɮano~uaŋ ko~uno~u natao~uran ħatiraʡaj ko~urairaj to~unano~u o~u to~uas ħatiraʡaj ko~uɾənak no~u mita o~u paŋʦaħ
